says: No law asserts that a handler failing with a typed error is answered with reason handler_failed; the only law that reads the reason drives a handler defect.
proof: The tests step planted err(job, "bad_cmd") at Runner.ts:2105 and the tracing law in runtime/EffectFunctions.test.ts stayed green. The one law that reads the reason, runtime/Runner.integration.test.ts mode throw, drives its handler with Effect.die, so a plant that answers only typed failures with another reason escapes both.
cost: A change that splits typed failures from defects in the runner's handler answer could send the wrong reason to update with every law green.
